changeSet.author: TDuric
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[Rules_Fields] AS select distinct O.ID as AssetID, O.ObjectID as RuleID, O.DisplayValue as RuleName, FT.ID as FieldTypeID, FT.Name as FieldName, FT.FriendlyName as FieldFriendlyName, case when fcv.value is not null then FT.CounterPrefix + cast(FCV.Value as nvarchar(50)) else F.FormattedValue end as FieldValue from AssetDetail O inner join AssetType AT on AT.uid = O.assettypeuid and at.class = 7 and at.State = 1 inner join FieldType FT on FT.Object = at.object and ft.objectid = at.objectid left join Field F on F.ObjectType = O.Object and F.ObjectID = O.ObjectID and F.FieldTypeId = FT.Id left join FieldCounterValue FCV on FCV.AssetId = O.ID and FCV.FieldTypeId = FT.Id where F.ID is not null or fcv.value is not null
changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[Rules_Fields] AS select O.ID as AssetID, O.ObjectID as RuleID, O.DisplayValue as RuleName, F.FieldTypeID, FT.Name as FieldName, FT.FriendlyName as FieldFriendlyName, F.FormattedValue as FieldValue from AssetDetail O inner join Field F on F.ObjectType = O.Object and F.ObjectID = O.ObjectID and O.AssetTypeClass = 7 and O.State = 1 inner join FieldType FT on FT.ID = F.FieldTypeID
